web_search.name: web_search
web_search.description: Search the public web and return ranked results.

apply_patch.name: apply_patch
apply_patch.description: Applies a structured patch (V4A-style diff) to create, update, or delete files.

patch.description: The full patch text, in the *** Begin Patch / *** End Patch envelope format.

fetch_url.name: fetch_url
fetch_url.description: Download a web page or call an API and return the text.

detect_changes.name: detect_changes
detect_changes.description: Use git (LibGit2Sharp) to find .cs files changed since base_ref (default HEAD~1), look up graph nodes for those files, and report impact sorted by degree. Includes blast-radius count of unique callers within depth 2. Read-only.

base_ref.description: Git ref or commit to diff against (e.g. HEAD~1, abc123). Default HEAD~1.

path_filter.description: Optional glob or substring to filter changed file paths (e.g. src/* or *Service.cs).

Write.name: Write
Write.description: Writes a file to the local filesystem, overwriting it if it already exists.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to write.

content.description: The content to write to the file.

browser_extract.name: browser_extract
browser_extract.description: Extract visible text from the current page, optionally scoped to a CSS selector (omit for the whole page).

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope extraction to; omit for the full page body.

image_gallery.name: image_gallery
image_gallery.description: List recent local Art Forge Studio gallery assets.

trace_path.name: trace_path
trace_path.description: Trace caller/callee paths in the code graph to a given depth. Uses structural CALLS edges (or DATA_FLOWS when available). Returns a plain-text indented tree. Read-only.

qualified_name.description: Fully qualified name of the starting symbol (from graph_search).

depth.description: Max depth to traverse. Default 3, max 8.

mode.description: calls | data_flow. 'calls' uses CALLS edges; 'data_flow' prefers DATA_FLOWS when present.
